newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's November home appliance sales up 5.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's November home appliance sales up 5.98 pct.

text.p: The volume of Brazilian home appliance sales rose 5.98 percent in November from a year earlier, the home appliance makers association Eletros said.
It said in a report that November figures showed a slowdown in sales growth. Sales jumped 21.44 percent in October from a year earlier.
Eletros forecast home appliance sales would rise 26.37 percent for all of 1996.
The Christmas season and the lengthening maturity of instalments continued to boost sales, it said.
November sales, in terms of units sold, rose a slight 0.19 percent from October.
In the first 11 months of 1996, sales rose 28.32 percent from the same period last year.
Eletros said November white goods sales jumped 23.67 percent from a year earlier, and portable appliance sales rose 37.7.
November sales of televisions and stereos dropped 7.9 percent from November 1995, it said.
